title: apply's rules anchor comes from the part of the lead passage the pack prints, and a no-fix record names the eval failure
goal: ql_apply.anchor_phrases takes candidates only from the text the pack prints of the lead or answer line, so a correct lead whose rarest phrase sits past the clip (the AGENTS.md/README.md gate question, lead kb/_self/tools.md:72, failed=text) yields a row that passes; and a no-fix record names the row's eval failure (text or anchor) rather than only 'eval fails' and an unchanged mean pack.
